scope.description: Seventh test function in the same harness file: a leader is elected between two real RawNodes with the append acknowledgement withheld, so it has no commit in its own term; a ReadIndex request is issued and observed to produce no read state; then the follower receives the append, its acknowledgement is fed back, and the released read state is observed.
assumptions: The delivery helper now acts as a correct application: HardState and Entries from each Ready are written to that node's MemoryStorage before Advance, and messages are delivered after that write, as the Ready contract requires.
Voters are {1,2,3} from equal snapshots at index=10/term=1 with CheckQuorum+PreVote; node 1 wins with its own vote plus node 3's, and node 2 is never contacted, so quorum is exactly two.
ReadOnlyOption is the default ReadOnlySafe, so the release path registers the request and confirms it with a heartbeat round trip.
excluded: Wall-clock timing; only logical ticks are used.

basis.prefix: Elect node 1 with the append acknowledgement withheld, emit its state, term, commit and outstanding appends, issue ReadIndex with a known context and emit the resulting ready (expecting no read states), then deliver the append to node 3, feed its acknowledgement back, emit the leader's per-peer Match/Next through RawNode.WithProgress and its commit, complete the release heartbeat round trip and emit the released read states with their index and context.
basis.responsibility: The raft module owns when an accepted read request is answered, and the application owns writing Ready entries to storage before their messages are sent.

comparisons.description: Queueing: a read request accepted while the leader has no commit in its term produces no read state.
Completion premise: the follower acknowledgement moves the leader's commit to index 11 in its own term.
Release: the queued request is answered with the commit index reached at release time.
Identity: the released read state carries the request context that was issued, so the answer is attributable to this request.
